text_block_list.text: One day, while I'm working in my<n>office...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I can't go losin' today's match!

Looks like Taiki Shuttle is pumping<n>herself up.
Although I don't<n>remember having any races
scheduled for today...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
This one decides it all... I'd go so far<n>as to call it my
final showdown.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, Trainer—you're comin' too! I<n>want ya to
witness my moment of<n>glory!

I find myself being taken somewhere<n>I never could
have imagined...

text_block_list.name: Rodeo Lady
text_block_list.text:
It's time for the local rodeo<n>competition, y'all! Let's
saddle up for<n>some ridin'!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeehaw!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yessiree! It's the day we've all been<n>watin' for!
But only one person can take home<n>all the glory!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Aww... I couldn't make it more than<n>five seconds...
This is one tricky challenge!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
If only I could have held on for just a<n>minute longer,
those ten kilos of steak<n>would've been mine...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah... I really wanted to eat it too...

Sounds like there's a grand-prize of<n>ten kilograms
of steak to be won.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Whew... I'm gettin' the shivers.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
My family back home used to say,<n>"Only a real
cowgirl knows how to<n>handle a buckin' bull."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Don't matter if it's real or<n>mechanical!
choice_data_list: You're really putting your all in this.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You bet I am! When I'm in this getup,<n>you can be
sure I mean business!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I know the real way to get a wild bull<n>to behave. I'll
stake my pride on it!

text_block_list.name: Rodeo Lady
text_block_list.text:
All right, y'all! Next up is contestant<n>number
nine—Taiki Shuttle!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That's right! The name's Taiki<n>Shuttle, and I'm a
real cowgirl!
Taiki strides confidently over to the<n>mechanical bull.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeehaw! Time for this cowgirl to<n>show y'all how
it's done!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Woohoo! Looks like I'm the champ!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
She rode that bull like it was second<n>nature... Guess
the steak prize is<n>going to her!
Wow! You were awesome out there!

Hehe! ♪ Thanks for the support, y'all.<n>That goes for
you too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Rodeo Lady
text_block_list.text:
Here are your ten kilograms of steak!<n>Don't forget
to take all this home with<n>you, okay?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, thank ya! I was so wrapped up in<n>the rodeo, I
forgot there even was a<n>prize!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Sorry, but do you have a second?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
You were amazing. The way you held<n>on no matter
what. And how you<n>handled those sudden turns
too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'd like you to give me some advice.<n>How can I get
to your level?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh! Well, lemme give it a think...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'm sure you've figured it out,Trainer! Why don't ya tell her for me?
choice_data_list: You need to be obsessed with food.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So that's what it is—appetite. A spirit<n>that hungers
for food. Maybe I should<n>have given up steak
before the rodeo<n>for motivation.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yep, appetite is key! I reckon I'd do<n>just about
anything for a juicy bit of<n>steak...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no! Don't go thinkin' I'm some<n>kind of a
glutton or something!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you sonuvagun! I can get<n>mad too, ya
know!

After that, Taiki Shuttle teaches Oguri<n>Cap the
secrets to bull riding.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: You know it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Bein' a cowgirl means having the<n>guts to represent
my entire<n>hometown! That's where my power
comes from!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I understand that feeling very well.<n>Thank you. I
should probably put in<n>more work.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Haha! That's the spirit, Oguri!

Taiki Shuttle says her goodbyes to<n>Oguri Cap,
happy and content.
